summary: Friendly and clear from the door to the order. You introduced yourself, told Luis about home in full sentences, and ordered without pointing. Next time try a follow-up question when Luis mentions the turtles.

scores.comment: «Hola, me llamo Zack» — right at the door, no hesitation.
«Soy de Missouri, en los Estados Unidos» — a full clause, then you let Luis carry it.
«Quiero un café de olla y una concha, por favor» — clear request form, no pointing.
